=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:107 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram alert for CRITICAL outcomes may fail silently, because the script calls tg_send_msg without checking its result or whether TG_BOT_SECRET/TG_ADMIN_CHAT_ID exist.
  WHY: The requirement "Every outcome is logged ... and sent to Telegram as CRITICAL" is not met if sending fails or is disabled by missing configuration; source severity was MAJOR, mapped to high; no other reviewer filed this as a finding.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "After a rollback, neither auto-release-stable.yml nor the promote-main-to-stable.yml cycle releases until a release is cut deliberately."
  expected_change_site: The poller-dispatched `promote` job in `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` and/or its `target_sha` dispatch path in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The hold check is only in `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh` (the scheduled cycle), and the `promote` job in `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` has no `stable_hold` reference (`promote` job lines 155-168), so it can bypass the hold. README.md:4807-4817 documents that the poller can dispatch this job after the rollback drain ends, so it can move `stable` forward and trigger a release that clears the hold. `scripts/rollback_stable.sh` stops cancelling runs after the first empty drain poll. Gemini and minimax note the gap is deferred: the Approach note exempts deliberate releases, the plan grant excludes these files, `agents.d/9342-stable-rollback.md:5` records it as a deliberate choice, and `README.md:4781-4785` documents the operator workaround. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this gap and accepted it as a documented residual, so they did not raise it.
- requirement: "Every outcome is logged under a stable prefix and sent to Telegram as CRITICAL."
  expected_change_site: The `TG_BOT_SECRET` / Telegram configuration in `.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml`, and `scripts/rollback_stable.sh::finish` (tg_send_msg call).
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow passes `TG_BOT_SECRET` and `TG_ADMIN_CHAT_ID` without requiring or validating them (`.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml:72-73`). `tg_send_msg` returns successfully without sending when the secret or chat ID is empty (`scripts/tg_helpers.sh:118-122`), and `finish` ignores send failures (`scripts/rollback_stable.sh:156`). A repo without Telegram configured therefore completes the rollback with only the STABLE_ROLLBACK log line. Severity disagreed: minimax said NIT and deferred it because TG_BOT_SECRET is optional repo-wide; openai said MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash accepted this as a residual and did not raise it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
